hints.title: A route bends at one node
hints.body: Every simple path has a highest node. At that node the route can use a downward branch on the left, a downward branch on the right, or both, but it cannot branch again below.

hints.title: Compute downward gains
hints.body: For each node, compute the best sum obtainable by starting at that node and descending into at most one child. Negative branches are better ignored.

hints.title: Combine at each node
hints.body: The best route whose highest node is the current node is the node's value plus the positive left gain and the positive right gain. Track the maximum over all nodes.

hints.title: Pseudocode
hints.body:
```
best = -infinity
function gain(node):
    if node is null: return 0
    left = max(gain(node.left), 0)
    right = max(gain(node.right), 0)
    best = max(best, node.value + left + right)
    return node.value + max(left, right)

gain(root)
return best
```

This is pseudocode, not a complete solution.
